Messages.Author: KoKo
Messages.Body:
Yo,

So I have been fairly successful with my OBE weenie Inceptor deck and I am looking to build more decks around this concept. I would appreciate, however, to hear what three cards you would put on Inceptor using any "exotic" disciplines that are considered rare, junk or whose crypt would benefit from a weenie. Please don't bother with Temporis. These decks a) are powerful enough, b) would not gain any significant benefits from playing Inceptor and c) bore me terribly.

That leaves three cards for each discipline/deck I am currently considering below:

Thanatosis Anarch (compliments G2-3 Samedi outferior)
Groaning Corpse
Dust to Dust
Diversion

Spiritus (as a versatile blocker that can snipe weenie and/or deflectors)
Ear of the Hare
Swiftness of the Stag
Charge of the Buffalo

THA/CEL/AUS (with Itzak and Alfred)
Pursuit
Theft of Vitae
Spirit's Touch

OBF/SER/POT (bringing down average cap. for crypt)
Lost in Crowd
Horseshoes
Temptation OR Enticement

Basically looking for anything out of the ordinary, perhaps focusing on outferiors and/or bloodlines as seen with some of the musings posted above.

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts, mates!

Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body:
Weenie block denial.

Siren's Lure
Anesthetic Touch
Disarm

Rest of the deck is weenie hackers with Andre Leroux or something. Preferably guys with aus so they can dodge with Anesthetic Touch. 2-6x Nightmares Upon Nightmares to burn excess Inceptors, depending on deck composition. Obligatory Uncoiling to get rid of NUN or Scourge of the Enochians.

Other suggestions for the combat cards:
Earth Meld
Outside the Hourglass + Disarm
Inner Essence + Morphean Blow
Resilience + Flames of the Netherworld (probably the most reliable and annoying)

All interesting ideas. This one is particular am not too fond of mostly because aggro poke is easily dealt with in combat heavy environments. And the hitback is usually brutal if they don't fear your 1 aggravated. From my experience, it's always better to hit back as hard if not harder than they do. Makes them think twice about pressuring you.. or at least makes it harder for them to do so when it cost them up to 4 blood a hit.

As i read inceptor, it says " can play the cards as though X had the discipline (if any) @superior"
So, its not pluralized. Singular.

But, they mentioned disarm plus anaesthetic touch earlier. Which is so funny i wish it worked with inceptor. So, as i read it, off limits.

Using it with inceptorcis neat, and gets a stack of kmw commons into a deck, but since March Halcyon is my facorite non-convert 1 cap (i like fortitude, and shes got the least sucky drawback of fortitude 1caps...), my brain immidiately jumps to "March can play skin of night..... because shes cool..... what else can i stick on inceptor?"
